projects.name: Trucode Dashboard System
projects.description: Enterprise Operational performance system built using MongoDB, Express, React, Node, and real-time Socket.IO communications.

projects.name: Cloud Infrastructure Migration
projects.description: Migrating legacy on-prem services to Kubernetes Cluster (EKS) in AWS with dynamic multi-tier monitoring.

projects.name: E-Commerce Mobile UX
projects.description: Redesigning the mobile experience to maximize checkout rate and streamline micro-animations.

phases.name: UI/UX & Requirements
phases.description: Wireframes, Styleguide definition, and functional specifications gathering.

phases.name: Core API Development
phases.description: Designing data structures, endpoints, JWT authentication flow, and notifications architecture.

phases.name: Deployment & QA
phases.description: Integration test suites execution, system validation, and CI/CD pipelines deployment.

phases.name: Audit & Planning
phases.description: Analyzing service dependencies and outlining target architecture on AWS.

phases.name: Migration Execution
phases.description: Setup Terraform variables, deploy Helm charts, and replicate databases.

phases.name: Design & Prototyping
phases.description: Wireframes, Styleguide definition, and high fidelity mobile prototypes.

phases.name: User Testing & Feedback
phases.description: Execute usability tests and gather quantitative feedbacks.
